purpose: To deliver to the Registrar a list of directors and Secretary of a foreign company along with their required particulars.
when: Within thirty days of establishment of its place of business in India
steps: Establish a place of business in India.
Compile the list of directors and Secretary containing all required particulars.
Deliver the list of directors and Secretary to the Registrar for registration within thirty days of establishment.
checklist: Personal name and surname in full
Any former name or names and surname or surnames in full
Father's name or mother's name or spouse's name
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
